notes: isiZulu has no grammatical gender, but noun-class prefixes and concords depend on the noun: nothing is attached to {name}/{building}/{troop}; a colon, an impersonal ku- verb or an apposition noun (isakhiwo {building}) is used instead. Personal-name subjects take the fixed class-1a concord u-.
Counts use the concord of the known counted noun with the copula ngu- before the number (amaqhawe angu-#, izinkanyezi ezingu-#), the usual isiZulu software convention.
Plural categories per Intl.PluralRules(zu): one (0 and 1) and other.

Generated names are noun-first with a space (generatedNames: noun-first; integration setting not yet set in languages.json): every second part (names.placeSecond, social.groveNames.second) is a class-9 noun, and every first part is a class-9 qualifier (possessive ya-/ye-/yo- or relative e-), so all pairs agree: Intaba yeNdudumo, Inqaba Ebomvu, Ingwe Ecashile.

Japanese statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are translated fully into isiZulu, following the Vietnamese pattern; the support page links them by their Japanese titles. Draft notices kept; not a lawyer review.
Term choices are in TERMS.md. No native isiZulu speaker has reviewed this translation.
